name: Decorus Carcer
source:
Decorus Carcer is about an on-the-side writer trying to overcome a writer's block - and what has essentially turned into a "life block" of sorts.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=13145]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

(Has graphics stolen from the Nintendo DS game "Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia.")
